edits.old_string: at every depth. On the ruling it lands at once
edits.new_string: at every depth; the ruling also decides whether the change takes a campaign (umbrellas.md § Review). On the ruling, and that campaign's close if it takes one, it lands at once

note: Binding-change paragraph: the operator's ruling now also decides whether the change takes a campaign (pointer to umbrellas.md § Review), and landing waits for that campaign's close when one is ruled.
